items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: "We've got a drummer that used to play with you," you know. He says, "What's his name?" "His name's Clyde Lucas."

ctx.x: And he says -- so, you know, Sammy finds out things, he went and told Basie, "We've got a drummer that used to play with you," you know. He says, "What's his name?" "His name's Clyde Lucas." He says, "I don't know about it. Maybe he did." You know, he said, "Guys come and go. I don't care who's there." You know. Let's go and play "One O'clock Jump."
